memes.caption: My workout plan: 10% exercise, 90% finding my other shoe.
Stretching is just yawning with extra steps.
"Just a five-minute walk." Forty minutes later: still walking.
Water: the original sports drink. Your bottle is calling.
Warm-up: where my muscles and I agree to be friends.
Step counter at 9,999. Time to pace around the kitchen.
Rest day: the workout nobody argues with.
Plot twist: the stairs were the gym all along.
My legs after leg day: "We need to talk." Also my legs: "Thanks, though."
The hardest part of any workout: the 30 seconds between the couch and the door.
Headphones on, world off, legs on autopilot.
Yoga mat unrolled: 50% done. Totally counts.
Friendly reminder from your mascot: have you had water lately?
"I'm not a morning person." Also me: loves the morning walk.
Bad day? Walk it out. Good day? Walk it out. Any day? Walk it out.
Treadmill: you run for ages, go nowhere, and feel great anyway.
Personal record unlocked: put on workout clothes without negotiating.
Pause. Roll your shoulders. Unclench your jaw. Carry on.
My bed: "Five more minutes." My alarm: "Run." We compromised on a stretch.
Sunshine plus sneakers equals instant good mood.
Matching socks: optional. Showing up: the real outfit.
Set a timer for 10 minutes. Surprise: you keep going.
The tortoise did not skip leg day and neither will you.
Exercise tip: pick the song that makes you want to dance, then dance.
